```go
type Cache struct {
    data     map[string]*CacheEntry
    mu       sync.RWMutex  // RWMutex for read optimization
    ttl      time.Duration
    loader   LoadFunc
    hits     atomic.Int64  // Atomic counters
    misses   atomic.Int64
    errors   atomic.Int64
    loadWait map[string]*sync.Cond  // Proper wait mechanism
}

func (c *Cache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (interface{}, error) {
    c.mu.RLock()
    entry, ok := c.data[key]
    if ok && time.Now().Before(entry.ExpiresAt) && !entry.Loading {
        c.mu.RUnlock()
        c.hits.Add(1)
        return entry.Value, nil
    }
    c.mu.RUnlock()

    c.mu.Lock()
    // ... double-check pattern with proper Cond signaling
    c.mu.Unlock()
}

func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{...}
}

func (c *Cache) GetMulti(ctx context.Context, keys []string) map[string]interface{} {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var resultsMu sync.Mutex
    results := make(map[string]interface{})
    
    for _, key := range keys {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(k string) {
            defer wg.Done()
            if val, err := c.Get(ctx, k); err == nil {
                resultsMu.Lock()
                results[k] = val
                resultsMu.Unlock()
            }
        }(key)
    }
    wg.Wait()
    return results
}
```
